fdr_scope: only the exact target_id x inchikey hypotheses in the pre-frozen allowlist; no target-compound cross-product hypotheses
dose_selection_null: maximum over every tested condition/dose is repeated within each permutation
statistic: signed full-profile Spearman; rank-1 task relevance and hypersensitivity are both oriented high
response_transform: sensitivity = +1 * signed vehicle-contrast z; abs(z) is not used
source_response_method: barcode response = median-polished log2 quantile-normalised expression (no background model) minus batch-matched vehicle median

axis_audit.permutation_storage: uint32 seed vector; permutations regenerated per batch
axis_audit.tail_fit: Gumbel moment fit on per-pair permutation null max-statistics (disclosed post-hoc 2026-09-12; Knijnenburg 2009 style); primary q columns remain emp_p-based

pair_allowlist.selection_basis: rerun of the frozen go_bridge_panel_20260912 single-pair allowlist (KCNH2 x amiodarone; original selection basis on file, declared blind), task axis replaced by V6 process-bridge H-arm export go_bridge_tasks_v6_20260912 (arm=H by pre-declared decision rule); allowlist bytes identical to frozen sha
pair_allowlist.freeze_contract: SHA-256 and independent selection basis validated before loading the HIP/HOP response matrix
